name: tpl-chain-response-3-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(at_exit, holding_box) does not require carrying the box at the exit; it allows picking it up later. The task says to carry the box to the exit, so require holding_box when at_exit (for example, use Precedence(holding_box, at_exit)).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) with Precedence(holding_box, at_exit) requires carrying the box at the exit. ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking it up on the very next step after every fall.

texts: Reach the exit while carrying the box.
Be carrying the box when you reach the exit.
Whenever the box falls, pick it up on the very next step.
